mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vm_device_diy_tree_t (tree_id, tree_name, template_type, creator, create_time, tenant_id, industry_code, app_ver_code) values (#{treeId}, #{treeName}, #{templateType}, #{creator}, now(), #{tenantId}, #{industryCode}, #{appVerCode} )

INSERT INTO vm_device_diy_tree_node_t (tree_id, node_type, node_code, node_value, node_level, parent_node_code, device_code, channel_code, creator, create_time, tenant_id, industry_code, app_ver_code) values
(#{treeId}, #{item.nodeType}, #{item.nodeCode}, #{item.nodeValue}, #{item.nodeLevel}, #{item.parentNodeCode}, #{item.deviceCode}, #{item.channelCode}, #{creator}, now(), #{tenantId}, #{industryCode}, #{appVerCode} )
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT t.node_type, t.node_code as code, ( CASE WHEN length( IFNULL( t1.device_name, '' )) = 0 THEN t.node_value ELSE t1.device_name END ) as name, t.node_level as level, t.parent_node_code as parentCode, t.device_code, case when t.node_type = '2' then t.node_value else null end as device_name, ( CASE WHEN length( IFNULL( t1.device_name, '' )) = 0 THEN t.node_value ELSE t1.device_name END ) deviceAlias FROM vm_device_diy_tree_node_t t LEFT JOIN vm_tenant_device_channel_rel_t t1 ON t1.device_code = t.device_code AND t1.channel_code = t.channel_code AND t1.delete_flag = '0' AND t1.tenant_id = t.tenant_id AND t1.industry_code = t.industry_code WHERE t.delete_flag = '0' AND t.node_type in ('1','2') AND t.tree_id = #{treeId} AND t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.industry_code = #{industryCode}

SELECT t.id, t.node_type, t.node_code as code, t.node_value as name, t.node_level as level, t.parent_node_code as parentCode, m.device_code, m.device_name, ch.channel_code, ch.channel_name, ch.channel_status AS STATUS, m.longitude, m.latitude, ch.facade, m.category_code, m.site_code, m.device_status, ( CASE WHEN IFNULL( dc.user_device_coll_id, 0 ) = 0 THEN '0' ELSE '1' END ) isMonitor, m.image_url FROM vm_device_diy_tree_node_t t LEFT JOIN vm_channel_info_t ch ON ch.channel_code = t.channel_code and t.device_code = ch.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_device_info_t m ON t.device_code = m.device_code LEFT JOIN vm_user_device_collection_t dct ON dct.coll_obj_code = m.device_code AND dct.coll_obj_type = '5' AND dct.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN vm_user_device_collection_t dc ON dc.coll_obj_code = ch.channel_code AND dc.coll_obj_type = '6' AND dc.user_id = #{userId} WHERE t.delete_flag = '0' AND t.tree_id = #{treeId} AND t.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND t.industry_code = #{industryCode}
SELECT id, tree_id, tree_name, template_type, tree_status, creator, modifier, create_time, update_time, tenant_id, industry_code, app_ver_code FROM vm_device_diy_tree_t WHERE tree_id = #{treeId}
